newsitem.title: USA: Telcom sees higher gross margins.
newsitem.headline: Telcom sees higher gross margins.

text.p: Telcom Semiconductor, which Wednesday reported a fourth quarter loss, said it is ramping up its wafer production, which should increase gross margins above third and fourth quarter levels.

"Revenues increased significantly in the fourth quarter over the previous quarter as demand picked up in all geographic regions," Phillip Drayer, president and chief executive officer said in a statement.

"It is disappointing to record a loss on this revenue level ($10.4 million). However, we have been operating the factory in the third and fourth quarters at a lower production rate than our shipping rate in order to decrease inventory," Drayer said.
He said the company reduced inventories by about $2.5 million from June 1996 to December 1996, but also suffered from "substantial unabsorbed overhead" which increased cost of sales.
